title: STRIDE-DREAD Threat Model: Microsoft Kinect Xbox 360 (v1) + Raspberry Pi 4 Trimodal IoT Edge Node

threats.description: High-volume UDP flood targeting Pi 4 exhausts network buffer and CPU preventing IDS from processing sensor streams
threats.attack_vector: hping3 UDP flood; Mirai botnet coordinated attack
threats.mitigation: RCAF Engine rate-limiting; iptables flood mitigation rules; SENTINEL-IoT DDoS detection via packet rate anomaly

threats.description: Unauthenticated MQTT client publishes false sensor readings to IDS alert topic suppressing or forging anomaly alerts
threats.attack_vector: mosquitto_pub injection of fabricated JSON payloads
threats.mitigation: MQTT authentication with TLS client certificates; topic ACL configuration in Mosquitto

threats.description: Network scanning reveals Pi 4 device fingerprint, open ports, and service versions enabling targeted attack preparation
threats.attack_vector: nmap -sV -O; Shodan IoT scanning; banner grabbing
threats.mitigation: Port hardening; service version masking; SENTINEL-IoT scan detection via connection rate monitoring

threats.description: Raw 320x240 depth frames contain body silhouette and gait patterns sufficient to identify individuals (biometric data under GDPR Article 4(14)) without any RGB data
threats.attack_vector: Network capture of unencrypted depth stream; local storage exfiltration
threats.mitigation: Depth-Silhouette Privacy Module: morphological erosion + calibrated Gaussian noise before any transmission or storage

threats.description: Unencrypted MQTT on port 1883 allows attacker to intercept and modify sensor data or IDS alerts in transit
threats.mitigation: MQTT over TLS 1.3; ECDSA-signed message payloads; certificate pinning at subscriber

threats.description: ARP cache poisoning redirects Pi 4 traffic through attacker machine enabling full MITM on all IoT communications
threats.attack_vector: arp-spoof; Ettercap gratuitous ARP; arpwatch evasion
threats.mitigation: Static ARP entries for known nodes; SENTINEL-IoT ARP anomaly detection in network monitor module

threats.description: Attacker removes MicroSD card and modifies OS or application code to insert backdoor or disable IDS components
threats.attack_vector: Physical card removal; dd imaging + hex editing + reinstall
threats.mitigation: dm-verity filesystem integrity checking; SENTINEL-IoT boot-time hash verification of all IDS binaries

threats.description: Physical access to USB ports enables insertion of malicious USB device or direct memory access via DMA attack
threats.attack_vector: Physical proximity, USB DMA (USB-C port on Pi 4)
threats.mitigation: SENTINEL-IoT physical enclosure with tamper-evident seals; USB port locking via udev rules blacklisting unknown VIDs

threats.description: Captured ECDSA authentication packets replayed to impersonate legitimate node without possessing private key
threats.attack_vector: Wireshark packet capture + Python replay script
threats.mitigation: Nonce-based challenge-response; timestamp binding with 5-second validity window; sequence number verification

threats.description: 16kHz audio capture from four-microphone beamforming array can record private conversations in monitored space
threats.attack_vector: Unencrypted audio buffer in memory; storage capture; network stream interception
threats.mitigation: Audio feature extraction only (MFCC) — raw audio never stored or transmitted; on-device anonymisation

threats.description: Attacker uses printed photo or video replay attack on Kinect RGB camera to confuse MobileNetV3 motion detection
threats.attack_vector: High-quality printed image held in front of camera; video display spoofing RGB stream
threats.mitigation: Depth stream cross-validation — RGB-only anomaly must be confirmed by corresponding depth occupancy change; texture liveness detection

threats.description: Triggering continuous maximum-load sensor processing (RGB+Depth+Audio at 30fps) exhausts Pi 4 CPU leaving no capacity for IDS inference
threats.attack_vector: Physical motion in front of Kinect causing continuous high-complexity scene; combined with network flood
threats.mitigation: RCAF Engine frame sampling at 10fps under load; CPU quota limits via systemd cgroups; graceful degradation to depth-only mode

threats.description: Malicious firmware or model update delivered via compromised update channel replaces legitimate RCAF engine with backdoored model
threats.attack_vector: MITM on HTTP update channel; DNS poisoning of update server
threats.mitigation: ECDSA-signed update packages; hash verification before install; HTTPS with certificate pinning for update channel

threats.description: Adversary crafts physical intrusion behavior that stays below detection threshold by moving slowly and using depth blind spots at <0.8m and >4.0m (Kinect v1 range limits)
threats.attack_vector: Kinect range exploitation; slow-movement adversarial walking
threats.mitigation: Cross-modal fusion — anomaly invisible in one stream detected in another; context-aware threshold adaptation

threats.description: Attacker gains write access to log files and deletes or modifies intrusion records to repudiate attack evidence
threats.attack_vector: Local filesystem access via SSH credential compromise; log rotation exploitation
threats.mitigation: Append-only log filesystem; SENTINEL-IoT log integrity via HMAC chaining of log entries

threats.description: Adversary disconnects Kinect and attaches spoofed USB device presenting same VID:PID (045e:02ae) to inject fake sensor data
threats.attack_vector: USB VID:PID cloning via hardware emulator (e.g., Facedancer)
threats.mitigation: ECDSA-signed sensor handshake; hardware serial binding in authentication module; USB device fingerprinting via timing analysis

threats.description: Malicious FL aggregator reconstructs private sensor data from gradient updates shared by edge nodes
threats.attack_vector: Gradient inversion attack (Geiping et al. 2020); membership inference via shadow models
threats.mitigation: (ε=1.0, δ=1e-5) Differential Privacy via Gaussian noise on gradients; gradient clipping (C=1.0)

threats.description: Vulnerability in IDS Python dependencies (TF Lite, OpenCV, libfreenect) exploited to escalate from sentinel user to root
threats.attack_vector: CVE exploitation in outdated packages; unsafe deserialization of model files
threats.mitigation: Principle of least privilege; IDS runs as sentinel user not root; regular apt security updates; model file signature verification

threats.description: Power consumption analysis of Pi 4 during ECDSA operations may leak private key bits via simple power analysis (SPA)
threats.attack_vector: Current probe on 5V power rail; oscilloscope capture during authentication handshakes
threats.mitigation: Constant-time ECDSA implementation (libgcrypt constant-time); noise injection via switched-mode power supply decoupling
